steps.js: (() => { window.__clicks=[]; const rec=(e)=>{ if(window.__clicks.length<8) window.__clicks.push({t:e.type,x:Math.round(e.clientX),y:Math.round(e.clientY),tag:e.target.tagName}); }; for(const t of ['mousedown','click']) document.addEventListener(t, rec, true); const btn=[...document.querySelectorAll('.search-panel button')].find(e=>e.getAttribute('aria-label')==='关闭'||e.textContent.trim()===''); const close=[...document.querySelectorAll('.search-panel button')].find(e=>(e.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')==='关闭'); const r=close.getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({closeCenter:{x:Math.round(r.x+r.width/2),y:Math.round(r.y+r.height/2)}, dlg:!!document.querySelector('.search-panel')}); })()
